messages.subject: Module 4, cannot specify study region
messages.body_plain:
I need to be able to specify the study region and I have tried to upload the coordinates to specify a bounding box with no success. I keep getting the same error:

Warning: Error in is.list: cannot derive coordinates from non-numeric matrix

I have tried the other methods and they work perfectly, but I need to be able to set the bounding box myself.

Thanks.

Alejandra

messages.subject: Re: Module 4, cannot specify study region
messages.body_plain:
Hi Alejandra,

I wonder if maybe you have a problem with your decimal delimiters in the matrix, you should be using points as decimal delimiters and your file should be a csv file. I can check if you send me the matrix.

Best,

Andrea

messages.subject: Wallace v1.9 (beta testing of what will become v2!)
messages.subject_clean: Wallace v1.9 (beta testing of what will become v2!)
messages.body_plain:
The Wallace development team and several external partners are ready for beta testing and feedback on a redesigned and expanded version.

What is new in this version?

Stop and start your work whenever you want.
Greater reproducibility regarding occurrence records.
Cross-time projections.
Make models for multiple species in the same Wallace session.
Environmental space comparisons.
Redesigned R-markdown functionalities.
... and more

Do you want to know more about beta testing?

Please take a look at this google document. <https://docs.google.com/document/d/13vpGbeVUWX-55ZMNNkPZgt5ahxzIfmp03Shhck8sPhI/edit?usp=sharing> It includes instructions for installation, a video showing the new features, and options to report bugs.

(Spanish) Intrucciones y video en español en la segunda parte del documento.

Best,

Wallace dev team
